_readme: Class profiles for the offline olive-leaf classifier. voice_script is spoken in English.

healthy.typical_visual_description: The leaf is clean. No spray is needed today.
healthy.voice_script: Farmer, this leaf looks healthy. Keep watering and light pruning. No spray is needed today.

diseased.typical_visual_description: The leaf has spots. They often look like peacock spot. Spray copper sulfate and ask an expert to confirm the disease.
diseased.voice_script: Farmer, this leaf has spots. Ask an expert to confirm what they are before you spray.

peacock_spot.typical_visual_description: Spray copper sulfate before the rain.
peacock_spot.voice_script: Farmer, this tree has peacock spot. Spray copper sulfate on this tree and the trees around it before the rain, so the disease does not spread.

olive_knot.typical_visual_description: Cut the galled branches and sterilize the tools.
olive_knot.voice_script: Farmer, this tree has olive knot. Cut off the galled branches and sterilize your tools with alcohol or a flame before you prune the next tree.

aculus_olearius.typical_visual_description: The leaf is deformed by mites.
aculus_olearius.voice_script: Farmer, this leaf shows mite damage. Check the nearby trees and ask an expert before you spray.

verticillium_wilt.typical_visual_description: A branch is wilting while the rest of the tree is still green.
verticillium_wilt.voice_script: Farmer, this looks like olive wilt. Do not move soil from this tree to the others, and ask an expert before you cut.

anthracnose.typical_visual_description: Fruit and leaf spots from anthracnose.
anthracnose.voice_script: Farmer, this looks like anthracnose. Remove the spotted fruit and leaves, and ask an expert about the spray.
